title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on How to Determine the Starting Date of "Within Five Years" After the Completion of the Execution of a Penalty for the Determination of Recidivism

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
December 28, 2018
Supreme People's Procuratorate
Reply on How to Determine the Starting Date of the “Five-Year” Period After the Completion of Punishment Execution for the Recognition of Recidivism
(Adopted at the 12th Session of the 13th Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on December 25, 2018)
Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate:
Your Request for Instructions on How to Determine the Starting Date of the Five-Year Period After the Completion of Punishment Execution for the Recognition of Recidivism has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
The term “completion of punishment execution” as provided in paragraph 1 of Article 65 of the Criminal Law refers to the date on which the punishment is due to be completed and the person shall be released. When determining the starting date of the “five-year” period after the completion of punishment execution for the recognition of recidivism, the calculation shall commence from the date of release upon completion of the sentence.
This reply is hereby given.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
December 28, 2018
(This document is distributed to the people's procuratorates at the county level)
Copied to: Legislative Affairs Commission of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Justice;
People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, Military Procuratorate,
People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps;
Leading comrades of this Procuratorate, full-time members of the Procuratorial Committee;
Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group stationed in the Procuratorate, all internal departments and directly affiliated institutions.
General Office of the Supreme People's Procuratorate Issued on December 29, 2018
Supreme People's Procuratorate
Gao Jian Fa Shi Zi [2018] No. 2
